nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor; controls winnerLimit and receives 10% of the pot.
Mapping address => uint8[] storing the country IDs owned by each player; mutated during buy and attack.
Fixed array of 178 addresses mapping each country ID to its current owner.
Dynamic array of all players who ever bought a country; scanned in isGameEnd to detect a winner.
Accumulated Ether pot (in wei) received via buyCountry and paid out by isGameEnd.
Stores the result of the last battle randomness computation (block hash modulo a+b).
Address of the winner of the last finished game.
Number of countries required to win the game; default 50, changeable only by the owner.
Fixed array of 15 addresses recording the last attacker, defender and battle results.
Constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Payable function that lets a player buy an unowned country for exactly 10 finney.
Core game logic: computes attacker/defender strength, derives randomness from block.blockhash, transfers countries between players and calls isGameEnd.
Checks whether a player reached winnerLimit, then distributes the pot with transfer() and resets all game state.
Owner-only setter for winnerLimit, protected by assert(msg.sender==owner).
Constant getter returning the full ownerofCountry array.
Constant getter returning totalmoney.
Constant getter returning a country ID at a given index for a given player.
Constant getter returning the number of countries owned by an address.
Constant getter returning the last battle randomness value lastR.
Constant getter returning the winnerloser array.
Constant getter returning the last finished game winner.
msg.sender: used as owner, buyer, attacker and payer identity throughout the contract.
totalmoney += msg.value in buyCountry: unchecked accumulation of Ether (arithmetic/overflow risk).
winner.transfer(totalmoney/10*9) and owner.transfer(totalmoney/10) in isGameEnd: external Ether sends before state is fully reset (reentrancy risk).
lastR = uint256(block.blockhash(block.number-1)) % (a+b): miner-influenced pseudo-randomness deciding the battle outcome (weak randomness / access control).
playerCountries[x].length = 0 and reset of ownerofCountry/playerList/winnerloser: direct storage-array length manipulation.
countryID parameter of buyCountry: index of the country to purchase.
countryID parameter of attackCountry: index of the country being attacked.
x parameter of setwinnerLimit: new winning threshold.
ax parameter of getaddr: player address lookup key.
bx parameter of getaddr: index into the player's country array.
ax parameter of len: player address lookup key.
attacker local variable in attackCountry, set from msg.sender.
defender local variable in attackCountry, set from ownerofCountry[countryID].
Attacker strength bucket 'a' derived from attacker's country count.
Defender strength bucket 'b' derived from defender's country count.
Loop counter i in attackCountry used for shifting winnerloser, transferring countries and iterating battles.
loopcount local in attackCountry holding the number of countries to transfer.
loopcount local in isGameEnd holding playerList.length.
winner local in isGameEnd, defaults to owner and becomes the payout recipient.
del boolean local in isGameEnd flagging that the game must be reset.
Loop counter i in isGameEnd used both as uint8 player loop and uint for state reset loops.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the constructor.
Constructor Risk() writes the owner state variable.
buyCountry executes the unchecked totalmoney += msg.value accumulation.
Unchecked addition updates totalmoney and can overflow with enough deposits.
countryID parameter feeds buyCountry.
countryID indexes ownerofCountry for the ownership assertion and assignment.
msg.sender is used as the key when pushing into playerCountries.
msg.sender becomes the new owner of the bought country.
msg.sender is appended to playerList on every buy.
msg.sender drives all assertions and state writes in buyCountry.
countryID parameter feeds attackCountry.
msg.sender determines the attacker identity and ownership assertions in attackCountry.
attacker local is assigned directly from msg.sender.
countryID indexes ownerofCountry to resolve the defender.
attacker local is used for strength computation and country transfer in attackCountry.
defender local drives the defender branch and country transfer in attackCountry.
Attacker strength bucket a selects the winning condition branch.
Defender strength bucket b participates in the battle outcome decision.
Loop counter i controls winnerloser shifting and country transfer loops.
loopcount determines how many countries are moved from loser to winner.
attackCountry computes battle randomness from block.blockhash(block.number-1).
The block-hash-derived value is written into lastR and decides the battle winner.
Attacker strength a is the modulus operand of the miner-influenced randomness.
Defender strength b is the modulus operand of the miner-influenced randomness.
Loser's country array is truncated via playerCountries[...].length = 0.
ownerofCountry entries are reassigned to the attacking player.
attackCountry performs direct storage array manipulation when transferring countries.
attackCountry calls isGameEnd after each battle.
isGameEnd performs external Ether transfers to winner and owner.
transfer amounts are computed from totalmoney and sent before state is fully cleared, enabling reentrancy.
The winner local receives 90% of the pot via an external transfer call.
loopcount bounds the winner-search loop over playerList.
winner local is the payout target and is stored in lastgameendWinner.
del flag gates the whole pot payout and state reset block.
Loop counter i iterates the players and the state-reset loops in isGameEnd.
playerList.length is set to 0 during the game reset.
All playerCountries arrays are cleared during the game reset.
ownerofCountry entries are zeroed during the game reset.
lastgameendWinner is updated with the winning player.
winnerloser history is zeroed during the game reset.
totalmoney is read for the 90/10 payout and then reset to zero.
x parameter supplies the new winnerLimit value.
msg.sender is asserted to equal owner in setwinnerLimit (access control).
setwinnerLimit writes the winnerLimit state variable.
ax parameter feeds the getaddr lookup.
bx parameter indexes the player's country array in getaddr.
ax parameter feeds the len lookup.
getaddr reads playerCountries.
len reads playerCountries[ax].length.
getCountryOwnershipList returns ownerofCountry.
getTotalBet returns totalmoney.
lastrandom returns lastR.
getwinnerloser returns winnerloser.
lastgamewinner returns lastgameendWinner.

normalization_plan.reason: countryID is only used as the index argument of buyCountry.
countryID is only used as the index argument of attackCountry.
x is only the new value assigned to winnerLimit inside setwinnerLimit.
ax is only used as the mapping key inside getaddr.
bx is only the array index inside getaddr.
ax is only used as the mapping key inside len.
attacker is a temporary alias of msg.sender inside attackCountry.
defender is a temporary alias of ownerofCountry[countryID] inside attackCountry.
a is the attacker strength bucket computed and consumed only in attackCountry.
b is the defender strength bucket computed and consumed only in attackCountry.
i is the loop counter used only within attackCountry.
loopcount bounds the country-transfer loop inside attackCountry.
loopcount holds playerList.length only inside isGameEnd.
winner is the payout recipient determined inside isGameEnd.
del gates the payout and reset block inside isGameEnd.
i is the loop counter used only within isGameEnd.
